title: 第十七章 外门第九百零一号杂役第十八章 重力加速度与扫地的关系
lines: 章节摘要：“这不叫受辱，叫侦查。侦查员不会因为要扫地就觉得自己低人一等。“——牛顿
浮空城从云层里落下来的时候，宁修远在金星宗穿梭艇的舷窗旁边站着，往下看。
他以前从下面看浮空城——仰着头，看那些垂下来的霓虹广告，看那些在雾霾里发光的符文，看不见城的形状，只看见城的底部。
现在他从上面看。
浮空城的顶部，是一层一层整齐的建筑群，按照高度分布，最高处的建筑最大，材质最精贵，往下走，建筑越来越小，最底层，是大片的灰色平台——那是外门区域，像一块没有被雕琢的原石，被粘在整个浮空城底部，往外突出去一截。
牛顿在他脑海里扫描了一圈：
“权力写在建筑高度里。高度越高，维护成本越高，能住在那里的人越少，稀缺性越强，修为要求越高。“
他停了一下：
“很古老的把戏，封建贵族都玩过。只是这里把阶级写成了'灵根品质'，比用血统更难被质疑——血统是偶然的，但灵根……他们把它包装成了努力和天道的结果。“
宁修远没有说话，只是看着那片灰色平台越来越近。
金星宗的穿梭艇在一个独立的停靠台完成交接。
两名天道院的执法修士在等着，表情职业，手里拿着一叠灰色的文书，对宁修远的态度介于“不屑“和“懒得不屑“之间——他是戴罪之身，在这里的权力逻辑里，连被认真对待的资格都不够。
他们对叶清欢的态度好了大约半个档次——金星宗挂靠弟子，身份需要被确认，流程需要被走完，但至少有完整的流程。
叶清欢跟在流程里，一言不发，寒系灵体的人设完美契合。
一个执法修士把一块灰色的胸牌递给宁修远，面朝上，上面没有任何符文，只有一行刻印的数字：
“这是你的编号。“执法修士看都没看他，翻着文书，“外门杂役级，戴罪观察期三个月，期满考核，由外门管事赵福负责评定。“
宁修远接过那块胸牌，看了一眼，把它别在胸口。
牛顿的声音响起，平静：
“这不是宗门，这是一家大型上市公司，只是股东是用修为来区分的。“
宁修远把胸牌别稳，跟着执法修士往里走。
外门区域的第一印象，是秩序。
不是仙山楼阁的那种灵秀，是另一种——很多人，在既定的路线上做既定的事，没有混乱，也没有生气，像是一台运转很久的机器，把每个零件打磨到了它该待的位置。
宁修远跟着被人群裹挟着走，ui自动开始工作：
[天道院外门·建筑结构扫描]
[主干道：5条·宽度约4米·承重混凝土结构]
[杂役区：东南角·建筑密度高·采光最差]
[藏经阁：主道中央偏北·独立建筑·能量屏蔽层可见]
[地下管网：可见部分延伸至西侧·具体走向未知]
宁修远扫了一眼那条标着“藏经阁“的位置，记下来，继续走。
灰色统一服的杂役们各自散向不同方向，像水流分叉一样自然——有人去挑水，有人去喂灵兽，有人推着推车从仓库方向出来，装着一些宁修远看不出是什么的材料。
没有人说话，没有人打招呼，就是走。
叶清欢在宁修远侧面走了一段，她的服装和宁修远的不一样——不是灰色，是一种更深的蓝灰，金星宗挂靠弟子的标准服色，领口有一个很小的金色标记。她的机械触须收拢在衣物下，完全看不出痕迹。
宁修远低声：“你的住处在哪边？“
“东侧第三排，独立单间。“叶清欢同样压低声音，但语气没有任何变化，很平静，像在汇报一个参数，“比你的条件好。“

Chapter summary: "This is not called humiliation, it is called investigation. Investigators do not feel inferior just because they have to sweep the floor." - Newton
When the floating city fell from the clouds, Ning Xiuyuan stood next to the porthole of the Venus Sect shuttle boat and looked down.
He used to look at the floating city from below - looking up at the hanging neon advertisements and the runes glowing in the haze. He couldn't see the shape of the city, only the bottom of the city.
Now he's looking from above.
The top of the floating city is a neat group of buildings, distributed according to height. The buildings at the highest point are the largest and made of the most precious materials. As you go down, the buildings become smaller and smaller. The bottom layer is a large gray platform - that is the outer door area. It is like an uncarved rough stone, which is glued to the bottom of the entire floating city and protrudes outward.
Newton scanned a circle in his mind:
"Power is written in the height of the building. The higher the height, the higher the maintenance cost, the fewer people who can live there, the stronger the scarcity, and the higher the cultivation requirements."
He paused:
"It's a very old trick that feudal nobles have played. It's just that class is written as 'spiritual quality' here, which is harder to question than using bloodline - bloodline is accidental, but spiritual root... they package it as the result of hard work and heaven."
Ning Xiuyuan didn't speak, just watched the gray platform getting closer and closer.
The Venus Sect's shuttle boat completed the handover at an independent docking station.
Two law enforcement monks from the Tiandao Temple were waiting, with professional expressions and a stack of gray documents in their hands. Their attitude towards Ning Xiuyuan was between "disdain" and "lazy disdain" - he was a guilty person, and in the logic of power here, he was not even qualified to be taken seriously.
Their attitude towards Ye Qinghuan has improved by about half a level - as a disciple of the Jinxing Sect, his identity needs to be confirmed and the process needs to be completed, but at least there is a complete process.
Ye Qinghuan followed the process without saying a word, and the character of the cold spirit perfectly fit.
A law enforcement monk handed a gray breastplate to Ning Xiuyuan, face up. There were no runes on it, only a line of engraved numbers:
0901
"This is your number." The law enforcement monk didn't even look at him as he flipped through the paperwork, "Outer sect servant level, with a probation period of three months. The evaluation after the expiration period will be assessed by Zhao Fu, the outer sect steward."
Ning Xiuyuan took the badge, took a look at it, and pinned it on his chest.
Newton's voice sounded calmly:
"This is not a sect, this is a large listed company, but the shareholders are distinguished by their cultivation."
Ning Xiuyuan fastened his badge firmly and followed the law enforcement monk inside.
The first impression of the outer door area is order.
It's not the kind of splendor of fairy mountains and pavilions, but another kind - a lot of people doing set things on a set route. There is no chaos and no life. It's like a machine that has been running for a long time, polishing every part to where it should be.
Ning Xiuyuan followed the crowd and the UI automatically started working:
[Tiandaoyuan outer gate·Building structure scan]
[Main roads: 5, width about 4 meters, load-bearing concrete structure]
[Merchant area: southeast corner, high building density, worst lighting]
[Zangjing Pavilion: North of the center of the main road·Independent building·The energy shielding layer is visible]
[Underground pipe network: The visible part extends to the west side·The specific direction is unknown]
Ning Xiuyuan glanced at the location marked "Sutra Collection Pavilion", noted it down, and continued walking.
The handymen in gray uniforms scattered in different directions, as naturally as the water flow bifurcated - some went to carry water, some went to feed the spirit beasts, and some pushed carts out from the direction of the warehouse, containing some materials that Ning Xiu couldn't tell from a distance.
No one spoke, no one said hello, just walked away.
Ye Qinghuan walked beside Ning Xiuyuan for a while. Her clothes were different from Ning Xiuyuan's - not gray, but a deeper blue-grey, the standard color of the Jinxing Sect's affiliated disciples, with a small gold mark on the collar. Her mechanical tentacles were tucked under her clothes, leaving no trace at all.
Ning Xiuyuan whispered: "Where is your residence?"
"Third row on the east side, independent single room." Ye Qinghuan also lowered his voice, but his tone did not change at all. It was very calm, as if reporting a parameter, "The conditions are better than yours."
